entities.summary: Sergey Nikolaevich Peskov was a Soviet-Russian diplomat who served as the Russian Ambassador to Pakistan from 2005 to 2009, and Russian Ambassador to Oman (2011–2013). He is the father of Dmitry Peskov who is the Press Secretary for the President of Russia, Vladimir Putin.
